title: Binary Tree Camera
statement:
You are given the root of a binary tree. We install cameras on the tree nodes where each camera at a node can monitor its parent, itself, and its immediate children.

Return the minimum number of cameras needed to monitor all nodes of the tree.
constraints:
1 <= The number of nodes in the tree <= 1000
0 <= Node.val <= 1000
inputFormat: A single line containing space-separated strings mapping the level-order traversal of the tree.
outputFormat: A single integer denoting the minimum cameras required.

examples.explanation: One camera is enough to monitor all nodes if placed on node 2.
At least two cameras are needed.
